narrative: HDI/PCL-diol/BDO fiber paired with IsPETase-derived hydrolase. Near-neutral pH cleavage (7.0–8.0) recovers caprolactone monomers for closed-loop repolymerization, diverting textile waste from landfill.

IPDI/PCL-diol/EDA fiber paired with FAST-PETase-derived hydrolase. The urea-extended hard segment provides spandex-class elastic recovery while the PCL soft segment enables enzymatic monomer recovery at pH 7.0–8.5.

H12MDI/polycarbonate-diol/BDO fiber paired with CalB-derived lipase. The polycarbonate soft segment provides hydrolytic stability in use but cleaves enzymatically under controlled conditions, recovering carbonate-diol monomers.
